name: Web Plura Catalog Readiness Auditor for Commerce
author: wplura

sections.description:
Web Plura Catalog Readiness Auditor helps WooCommerce stores find product data issues that can block or weaken shopping listings, product discovery, and catalog readiness.

The free plugin is local-first, WooCommerce-only, and useful without an external service account.

Free version features

  • Local WooCommerce product catalog-readiness audits from the WordPress dashboard.
  • Bounded scan controls for starting, resuming, cancelling, resetting, and reviewing local product audits.
  • Checks for missing or weak titles, descriptions, images, prices, categories, product URLs, SKUs, stock status, shipping details, and downloadable-file setup where locally detectable.
  • Identifier and product-data checks for locally available GTIN, MPN, brand, condition, duplicate titles, duplicate descriptions, and duplicate SKUs.
  • Visibility, technical discoverability, media quality, trust-policy, product data, shopping-feed readiness, and AI product discovery readiness scores.
  • Product issue review, severity grouping, product readiness summaries, local audit history, CSV exports, and printable summaries for client or internal review.
  • Local settings for consent, scan limits, retention, image thresholds, ignored products, and ignored issue types.
  • No external account requirement, no automatic external service requests, and no product report data transmission from the free plugin.

The plugin does not generate product feed files. It focuses on WooCommerce readiness checks and issue review before catalog rejection, poor listing quality, or missing product context causes avoidable work.

This free plugin keeps audits, history, exports, and consent controls local to WordPress. Scores and findings are deterministic local estimates and do not guarantee commerce platform approval, search placement, advertising performance, AI answer inclusion, or product ranking.

Product page: https://wplura.com/products/web-plura-catalog-readiness-auditor
Terms: https://wplura.com/terms
Privacy: https://wplura.com/privacy

External Services

This free plugin does not make automatic external service requests and does not transmit product report data externally.

The product, terms, privacy, and compare-plan links in the plugin and readme are user-clicked links only. Opening those links takes the user to Web Plura pages in a browser; no local product audit data, product report data, product scores, scan history, or product issue details are sent by the free plugin.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from the WordPress Plugins screen or upload the plugin ZIP file.
  2. Activate Catalog Readiness Auditor from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open Catalog Readiness Auditor in the WordPress dashboard.
  4. Accept local processing consent.
  5. Run your first local audit from the Dashboard.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a paid account?

No. Free local audits work after local consent is accepted.

Does the plugin generate product feeds?

No. This initial release audits WooCommerce product visibility, catalog readiness, and local product data quality. It does not generate product feed files.

Which ecommerce platforms are supported?

The free plugin supports WooCommerce product audits only. The separate Pro add-on can support additional commerce platforms such as Easy Digital Downloads and SureCart where available through the Pro package.

What data is sent externally?

The free plugin does not transmit product report data externally.

Do scores guarantee approval, ranking, or AI inclusion?

No. Scores are local readiness estimates for review and prioritization. They do not guarantee commerce platform approval, search placement, advertising performance, AI answer inclusion, or product ranking.

Does the plugin handle purchase or payment checkout inside WordPress?

No. It only audits locally visible WooCommerce product catalog readiness data and does not process purchases or payments.
